description: Table 6, rendered as a single image table (no panels), titled / captioned "Lattice parameters of different inclusion". It has three columns headed "Inclusion", "Lattice parameters [Å]" and "References", and four data rows listed top to bottom: AlN, MnS, Al₂O₃ and TiN. Row 1 (AlN) gives a_AlN = b_AlN = 3.110, c_AlN = 4.980 Å with reference [48]; the two equal basal parameters with a different c value are consistent with a hexagonal cell. Row 2 (MnS) gives a_MnS = b_MnS = c_MnS = 5.224 Å, reference [49], i.e. a cubic cell. Row 3 (Al₂O₃) gives a_Al₂O₃ = b_Al₂O₃ = 4.759, c_Al₂O₃ = 12.991 Å, reference [50], again a=b≠c. Row 4 (TiN) gives a value of 4.242 Å for all three axes with reference [5]; in the supplied image the subscripts in this row are printed as a_MnS = b_MnS = c_MnS even though the row is labelled TiN — an apparent typesetting inconsistency in the source table. No other quantities, units, images or micrographs appear. The table supplies the crystallographic reference data used elsewhere in the paper to index the AlN, MnS, Al₂O₃ and TiN inclusions identified by SEM/EDS.

subfigures.description: Single tabular image with three columns (Inclusion, Lattice parameters [Å], References) and four rows: AlN (a=b=3.110, c=4.980 Å; [48]), MnS (a=b=c=5.224 Å; [49]), Al₂O₃ (a=b=4.759, c=12.991 Å; [50]), TiN (a=b=c=4.242 Å in the printed text with MnS subscripts; [5]).

observations.observation: The table lists exactly four inclusion phases: AlN, MnS, Al₂O₃ and TiN, in that top-to-bottom order.
Column headers are printed as 'Inclusion', 'Lattice parameters [Å]' and 'References'.
AlN is given as a_AlN = b_AlN = 3.110 Å and c_AlN = 4.980 Å, with reference [48].
MnS is given as a_MnS = b_MnS = c_MnS = 5.224 Å, with reference [49].
Al₂O₃ is given as a_Al₂O₃ = b_Al₂O₃ = 4.759 Å and c_Al₂O₃ = 12.991 Å, with reference [50].
The TiN row gives a lattice parameter of 4.242 Å equal along all three axes, with reference [5].
In the printed table the TiN row uses the subscripts a_MnS = b_MnS = c_MnS rather than TiN subscripts — a visible inconsistency between the row label and its symbol subscript.
The unit for the lattice parameters is Å, as printed in the column header 'Lattice parameters [Å]'.
The four reference markers cited in the rows are [48], [49], [50] and [5], in table order.
The caption states the table gives 'Lattice parameters of different inclusion'.
AlN and Al₂O₃ both have two equal parameters (a = b) with a different c, consistent with a hexagonal unit cell, whereas MnS and TiN have a = b = c, consistent with a cubic cell.
